# Shadow Arrow - High-Performance Web Engineering Studio

> Shadow Arrow is a premier web engineering studio led by founder Bijoy Lohar. We specialize in custom full-stack web applications, Next.js 14 platforms, headless e-commerce engines, scalable APIs, and GST-compliant B2B solutions.

## Core Capabilities
- **Full-Stack Development**: React 19, Next.js 14 App Router, TypeScript, Node.js, Python, Supabase, PostgreSQL.
- **Performance Engineering**: Sub-second page load speeds, Google Core Web Vitals optimization, zero-layout-shift responsive design for mobile and desktop.
- **B2B GST Invoicing & Compliance**: Verified GST-compliant invoice generation, milestone billing, and contract-backed delivery.
